title: Simple NightVision
description: A Simple Night Vision Plugin that works out-of-the-box.
body:
# **SimpleNV**

A **lightweight** Minecraft plugin that gives players instant access to Night Vision / Fullbright toggles with **zero setup required**.

## ✨ **Overview**

**SimpleNV** lets players **instantly** toggle improved visibility in-game using simple commands.
**No permissions**. **No config**. **No dependencies**. Just drop it in and it works.

Perfect for **survival** servers, creative building, testing worlds, or anywhere visibility matters.

## ⚡ **Features**
- 🔆 Instant Night Vision / Fullbright toggle
- 🎮 Fully in-game only, no setup required
- 🧩 No permissions system needed
- 🪶 Lightweight and performance-friendly
- 🔁 Toggle system (turn it on or off with the same command)
- 🛠️ Plug-and-play installation
- 💬 Commands

## **Command	Description**

| Command          | Description          |
| ---------------- | -------------------- |
| **/nv**          | Toggles Night Vision |
| **/nightvision** | Toggles Night Vision |
| **/simplenv**    | Toggles Night Vision |


All commands do the same thing for convenience.

<details>
<summary>🚀 Installation</summary>

1. **Download** the **plugin.jar**
2. **Drop it into your server’s plugins folder**
3. **Restart** the server
4. Use any command instantly

**No config files. No setup. No permissions.**
</details>

<details>
<summary>🧠 How it works</summary>

Applies Night Vision effect when enabled

Removes it when toggled off

Works per-player only

Does not interfere with other potion effects (except Night Vision)
</details>

SimpleNV keeps it fast, clean, and effortless.
